title: Common Plants & Trees
keyIdea: Name common wild and garden plants (daisy, grass, rose, dandelion, oak, holly). Deciduous trees lose their leaves in autumn; evergreen trees keep green leaves all year. Match a plant to its name from a picture or clue.
familyTip: On a walk, point to a daisy, some grass, an oak and a holly. Ask: 'Which tree keeps its leaves in winter?' Sort fallen leaves vs still-green holly.

visual.caption: Loses leaves or keeps them? Drag each tree, or tap it and then tap a box.

lab.caption: Flagship lab: name common plants, sort deciduous vs evergreen and wild vs garden, match clues, and catch plant myths.

kid: Plants and trees have names. A daisy is a small flower. Grass grows in short green blades. A rose often grows in a garden.
Some trees lose their leaves in autumn. We call them deciduous. Oak and beech do this.
Some trees keep green leaves all year. We call them evergreen. Holly and many firs do this.
Wild plants grow in fields and hedges. Garden plants are grown on purpose in flower beds.
adult: Year 1 Science (plants): identify and name common wild and garden plants, including deciduous and evergreen trees. Words: deciduous, evergreen, wild, garden, oak, holly, daisy, grass, rose.
Common mistakes: thinking every tree loses all its leaves; calling holly deciduous; saying grass is not a plant; mixing plant parts (roots/stem) with naming whole plants.
In the lab your child names a daisy, sorts lose-vs-keep leaves, sorts wild vs garden, matches an evergreen clue to holly, picks true sentences, then faces challenge traps for those slips.

practice.hint: Think of a small white flower with a yellow middle.
practice.explain: A daisy is a common flowering plant. It is not a rock or an oak tree.

practice.hint: Oak and beech look bare in winter.
practice.explain: Deciduous trees lose their leaves in autumn. Evergreens keep leaves.

pool.prompt: A rose in a flower bed is…
pool.hint: Garden plants are grown on purpose.

pool.hint: Green blades under your feet are still plants.
pool.explain: Grass is a common plant — not a tree and not 'not a plant'.

pool.explain: Oak is deciduous — it loses leaves. Holly keeps leaves.

choices: oak loses leaves; holly keeps them
pool.hint: Deciduous trees lose leaves; evergreen trees keep them.

pool.prompt: Wild nettles by a path are…
pool.hint: They grow free by the path, not planted in a bed.
pool.explain: Nettles by a path are wild plants, not garden roses.
